description: City of Melbourne publishes selected building attributes from the City of Melbourne Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE): location, building name, construction year, refurbished year, number of floors above ground, predominant space use, bicycle spaces, showers and building accessibility type and rating. Coverage: the City of Melbourne municipality, Australia; census years 2002 to 2024 according to the description, about 305,000 records, portal record last modified on 2021-11-02. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the City of Melbourne open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY; cost: free. Caveats: the provider says the data are a community service, may contain errors or omissions and are liable to change; the portal modification date (2021) is older than the census period stated in the text, so the latest census year in the file was not confirmed. Simulation uses: building age, height and use distributions for exposure and retrofit models, and building-stock change over time. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
